description: Pouch.me: send a quote request to our team for your user. We email your user a confirmation link first; the request reaches our team only after they confirm it themselves (don't click it for them). Our team reviews it; if it's something we can make, we reply by email with a written quote or a question about the spec. No reply time is given. Requires customer_consent=true. Returns a reference number. Does not create an order.

is_ai_agent.description: True if an AI agent is submitting on the customer's behalf.
is_ai_agent.title: Is Ai Agent

blank_sample_set.description: True if the customer wants a set of blank (unprinted) clear sample bags for $10, credited back as $25 off their order. US addresses; outside the US, say so in notes. We send the stocked size closest to theirs; not every size or style is stocked.
blank_sample_set.title: Blank Sample Set

customer_consent.description: True only if the customer asked for this quote and agreed to be emailed by Pouch.me.
customer_consent.title: Customer Consent

fill_amount.description: How much goes in each bag, e.g. '12 oz' or '250 g'. Ask the customer; don't guess.
fill_amount.title: Fill Amount

food_shelf_life_target.description: For food: how long the product must last on shelf, in the customer's words. We use it to recommend a material; shelf life depends on several factors and isn't guaranteed.
food_shelf_life_target.title: Food Shelf Life Target

needed_by.description: Date the customer needs bags in hand, if any. Giving a date here doesn't mean it can be met; only our team can say that, after checking with production.
needed_by.title: Needed By

product.description: What goes in the bag, e.g. 'whole bean coffee'.
product.title: Product

quantities.description: Total bags per quote option, e.g. [500, 1000].
quantities.title: Quantities

size.description: Bag size if the customer knows it, with units, e.g. '6 x 9 x 3.5 in'.
size.title: Size

sizing_reference.description: The sizing_reference from recommend_bag_size, if you sized the bag with it. Our team then sees that recommended size on the request.
sizing_reference.title: Sizing Reference

name: submit_quote_request
title: Submit a quote request
